name: Fjord
description: A calm, Scandinavian home & living theme. Muted sage and warm stone tones, a clean grotesque display over Inter, and airy room-set layouts made for furniture, homeware and decor.

blocks.heading: A calmer home
blocks.subheading: Considered furniture and homeware, made from honest materials and built to last.

settings.text: Free delivery on furniture  ·  Natural materials  ·  Made to last  ·  5-year guarantee

settings.heading: Design that disappears into daily life
settings.body: The best pieces don't demand attention — they earn their place quietly. We design for calm: clean lines, natural textures and objects that feel right the moment they're home.

settings.heading: Honest, natural materials
settings.body: Solid oak and ash, full-grain leather, wool and stoneware — materials that wear in, not out. Everything we make is designed to be repaired, not replaced.

blocks.quote: The oak table is a piece we'll pass on. Faultless quality and it arrived beautifully packed.
blocks.author: Verified buyer

blocks.quote: Everything feels calm and considered — exactly what our home needed.
blocks.author: Loyal customer

blocks.quote: Ordered a chair, ended up furnishing the whole living room. No regrets.
blocks.author: Repeat customer

settings.heading: Ideas for a calmer home
settings.subtext: Room inspiration, new arrivals and members-only offers — a little letter, now and then.

blocks.heading: Free furniture delivery
blocks.text: Room-of-choice delivery on larger pieces, included.

blocks.heading: 5-year guarantee
blocks.text: We stand behind everything we make.

blocks.heading: 100-day returns
blocks.text: Live with it. Not right? Return within 100 days.

settings.heading: A workshop and a simple idea
settings.body: Fjord started with the belief that a home should feel calm, not cluttered — and that good design shouldn't mean disposable design. We work with makers who share that patience.

settings.heading: Built by people who care
settings.body: Joints that are cut, not stapled. Finishes applied by hand. Every piece is made to be lived with for decades and repaired if it ever needs it.

settings.heading: Delivered with care
settings.body: Larger furniture is delivered to your room of choice by a two-person team, unpacked and ready to enjoy — with all packaging taken away.

blocks.question: How long does furniture take to arrive?
blocks.answer: In-stock furniture is delivered within 1–2 weeks; made-to-order pieces take 4–6 weeks. Homeware and smaller items ship within 48 hours.

blocks.question: Do you deliver and assemble?
blocks.answer: Larger pieces come with room-of-choice delivery by a two-person team. Most items need little or no assembly; where they do, clear instructions and tools are included.

blocks.question: What is your returns policy?
blocks.answer: Live with a piece for up to 100 days. If it isn't right, arrange a collection for a full refund — we only ask that it's in re-saleable condition.

blocks.question: What does the 5-year guarantee cover?
blocks.answer: Every piece of furniture is guaranteed against manufacturing faults for five years. If something goes wrong, we'll repair or replace it.

blocks.question: Where do you source your materials?
blocks.answer: All our timber is FSC-certified and traceable, and we work only with makers who meet our standards for materials and working conditions.
